articles.summary: Every year, more than 200 graduates join Santander CIB, taking their first steps in careers that could take them further than they can yet imagine.Before the title and the experience, before anyone knew your name, there was a first day.A little fear. articles.title: A whole career ahead: meet the next generation of talent at Santander CIB

articles.summary: The European Stability Mechanism (ESM) has raised €1 billion through the sale of its first digitally native bond, with Santander CIB acting as Joint Bookrunner.The transaction is designed to combine distributed ledger technology (DLT) with the operational familiarity of a traditional bond, enabling investors enabling investors to retain the same rights and issuer credit risk profile associated with conventional ESM issuances.
articles.title: Santander supports ESM’s first €1 billion Digitally Native Note

articles.title: Paris Institutional Markets Event 2026 brings together clients and market experts to discuss the outlook for global markets

articles.summary: Santander continues to strengthen its investment banking franchise in Spain, supported by strong activity across M&A and equity capital markets.Santander Corporate & Investment Banking (Santander CIB) has strengthened its position in the Spanish investment banking market, according to an analysis published by Expansión based on preliminary Dealogic data. The report highlights the strong momentum in investment banking activity in Spain and Santander's leading position in the market.
articles.title: Santander builds on its leadership in Spain's investment banking market
